## Independent reviewer reproduction

```powershell
$env:NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED = '1'
$env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE = '1'
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/consultation-commitment.test.ts
corepack pnpm run ci
py -3 -m unittest discover -s tests/governance -p "test_*.py" -v
git diff --check
git status --short --branch
```

Pass means the focused suite reports 4/4, full CI reports 105/105 across 13 files and exits `0`, governance reports 7/7, diff check has no errors, and only the 18 documented Prompt 14 plus Prompt 13 acceptance-reconciliation paths are changed. Passing does not mark PB2-14 ACCEPTED.

## Diff summary

The change replaces the generic commitment envelope with the canonical registry, adds strict structured consultation packages and explicit TEST_ONLY legal/response/conflict policies, and routes consultation through the accepted atomic command path. Player-known conflict/risk preview remains knowledge-safe; typed actor response happens only after commit; evidence and commitments are traceable. An opt-in source-step-3 adapter transitions due commitments once with deterministic event/memory callbacks. It adds no production law, real stance, automatic agreement, free-form authoritative negotiation, or second mutable source of truth.
